templates.pattern: [P1] said 'The man in the photograph is the only son of the father of my sister.' How is the man related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: Father of my sister = my father. Only son of my father = myself (if [P1] is male) or brother. Since 'only son' = [P1] himself. The man is [P1] himself → Brother.

templates.pattern: Pointing to [P1], [P2] says 'His father is the only son of my grandfather.' How is [P2] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: My grandfather's only son = my father. [P1]'s father = [P2]'s father. So [P1] and [P2] are siblings. [P2] is Sister of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] has two children [P2] and [P3]. [P2] is married to [P4]. [P4]'s father is [P5]. [P5] has no other children. How is [P3] related to [P5]?
templates.explanation: [P2] married [P4]. [P5] is father of [P4]. [P3] is sibling of [P2]. So [P3] is Co-parent-in-law of [P5].

templates.pattern: In a family code: 'A@B' means A is the mother of B, 'A#B' means A is the brother of B, 'A$B' means A is the husband of B. If [P1]@[P2]#[P3]$[P4], how is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1]@[P2] → [P1] is mother of [P2]. [P2]#[P3] → [P2] is brother of [P3]. [P3]$[P4] → [P3] is husband of [P4]. [P4] is wife of [P1]'s son = Daughter-in-law of [P1].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the father of [P2]. [P2] is the sister of [P3]. [P3] is the father of [P4]. [P4] is the only child. How is [P1] related to [P4]?
templates.explanation: [P1] is father of [P2] and [P3] (siblings). [P3] is father of [P4]. So [P1] is Paternal Grandfather of [P4].

templates.pattern: [P1]'s brother's sister's mother's husband's son is [P2]. How is [P2] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1]'s brother's sister = [P1] herself/himself. [P1]'s mother's husband = [P1]'s father. Father's son = [P1]'s brother. So [P2] is Brother of [P1].

templates.pattern: In a coded family: 'P%Q' means P is the father of Q. 'P&Q' means P is the wife of Q. 'P*Q' means P is the sister of Q. If [P1]%[P2]&[P3]*[P4], how is [P4] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P1]%[P2] → [P1] is father of [P2]. [P2]&[P3] → [P2] is wife of [P3]. [P3]*[P4] → [P3] is sister of [P4]. [P4] is brother-in-law of [P2] = Son-in-law's brother.

templates.pattern: [P1] is the only child of [P2]. [P3] is [P1]'s mother. [P4] is [P3]'s father-in-law. [P5] is [P4]'s wife. How is [P5] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P2] is father of [P1]. [P3] is mother of [P1]. [P4] is [P3]'s father-in-law = [P2]'s father = [P1]'s paternal grandfather. [P5] is wife of [P4] = [P1]'s Paternal Grandmother.

templates.pattern: Pointing at [P1], [P2] told [P3]: 'His mother is the sister of your father.' How is [P1] related to [P3]?
templates.explanation: [P1]'s mother is sister of [P3]'s father. So [P1]'s mother and [P3]'s father are siblings. [P1] is Cousin of [P3].

templates.pattern: [P1] is the son of [P2]. [P3] is the brother of [P2]. [P3]'s wife is [P4]. [P4]'s daughter is [P5]. How is [P5] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: [P2] and [P3] are siblings. [P1] is child of [P2], [P5] is child of [P3]. They are Cousins.

templates.pattern: [P1]'s father's sister's son is [P2]. [P2]'s sister is [P3]. How is [P3] related to [P1]?
templates.explanation: Father's sister = aunt. Aunt's son = cousin = [P2]. [P2]'s sister = another cousin. [P3] is Cousin of [P1].

templates.pattern: A is the mother of B. B is the brother of C. C is the daughter of D. E is the husband of A. How is E related to C?
templates.explanation: A is mother of B and C. E is husband of A. So E is Father of C.

templates.pattern: Pointing to [P1] in a photograph, [P2] says 'I am the only son of [P1]'s paternal grandfather's son.' How is [P1] related to [P2]?
templates.explanation: [P1]'s paternal grandfather's son = [P1]'s father (or uncle). If only son, then = [P1]'s father. [P2] is only son of [P1]'s father = [P2] is [P1]'s Brother.
